# MIKA Coral Gables

> MIKA is Chef Michael White's Coastal Italian restaurant at The Plaza Coral Gables in Miami, Florida. It opened on December 12, 2024 and serves handmade pasta, crudo and caviar, whole fish, dry-aged steaks and a 1,700-bottle wine cellar in a Mediterranean dining room designed by Bishop Design.

## Key facts

- Name: MIKA Coral Gables (MIKA)
- Cuisine: Coastal Italian, Mediterranean, seafood
- Chef & owner: Michael White — six Michelin stars across his career, James Beard Award winner, founder of Marea in New York
- Address: 3007 Ponce de Leon Blvd, Coral Gables, FL 33134, United States (at The Plaza Coral Gables)
- Coordinates: 25.745099, -80.258146
- Phone: +1 305 404 2200
- Email: hello@mikacoralgables.com
- Price range: $$$$
- Opened: December 12, 2024
- Dining room: 100 seats · Private dining room: 36 seats / roughly 600 sq ft · Total: 8,195 sq ft
- Cellar: roughly 1,700 bottles
- Dress code: smart casual (no shorts, hats, tank tops, flip flops, or athletic attire)
- Parking: valet at The Plaza Coral Gables
- Corkage: up to two 750ml bottles per table, $75 per bottle
- Service charge: 18% for parties of 10 or fewer; 23% for 11 or more
- Reservations: OpenTable (instant) and Resy (90 days ahead); parties of 9+ through private dining
- Ratings: OpenTable 4.8 (40 reviews), Resy 4.8 (3.3K ratings), Google 4.7 (662 reviews)

## Chef Michael White

- Full name: Michael John White
- Born: Beloit, Wisconsin, United States
- Training: Kendall College, Chicago (1989); Ristorante San Domenico, Imola, Italy (seven years under Valentino Marcattilii); stages in Paris and the South of France
- Career: Spiaggia, Chicago → Fiamma Osteria, New York (2002) → Altamarea Group with Ahmass Fakahany (2007) → Marea (2009) → Ai Fiori (2010) → MIKA (2024)
- Michelin: six stars earned across his New York restaurants, including two at Marea and one at Ai Fiori
- James Beard: Best New Restaurant 2010, Marea; Best Chef: New York nominee 2010–2014
- Books: _Fiamma_ (2006), _Classico e Moderno_ (2013)
- Now: Chef & Owner, MIKA Coral Gables; also Santi (New York), Paranza (Bahamas), Levant (San Juan), Lions Den (Dallas)
- Philosophy: "Truffles and blue jeans. Come as you are." Simple food, precise technique, handmade pasta, warm hospitality.
- Chef page: https://www.mikacoralgables.com/chef/

MIKA is White's first stand-alone restaurant in Florida. He opened it on December 12, 2024 at The Plaza Coral Gables with partner Alex Pirez and operator Matt Safchik. The name is an Italian nickname for Michael and also the name of Pirez's daughter. The dinner menu includes the Marea classic — fusilli with red wine braised octopus and bone marrow ragu ($58).

## Hours (America/New_York)

- Lunch: Monday–Friday, 11:30am–3:00pm
- Aperitivo: Monday–Friday, 4:00pm–7:00pm (bar and lounge)
- Dinner: Monday–Thursday 5:30pm–10:00pm; Friday–Saturday 5:30pm–11:00pm; Sunday 5:00pm–8:30pm
- Brunch: Sunday, 12:00pm–4:00pm

## Menus

- [Dinner](https://www.mikacoralgables.com/menu/): crostini, crudi, antipasti, pasta and risotto, secondi, bistecca, contorni
- [Lunch](https://www.mikacoralgables.com/menu/): Monday–Friday; two-course prix fixe $42, three-course $48
- [Sunday Supper](https://www.mikacoralgables.com/menu/): Sunday brunch until 4pm and dinner from 5pm
- [Aperitivo](https://www.mikacoralgables.com/menu/): Monday–Friday 4–7pm; small bites, cocktails, wine and beer
- [Miami Spice](https://www.mikacoralgables.com/menu/): three-course prix fixe $65, Sunday–Thursday, August–October

Signature dishes include Spaghetti with blue crab and Siberian sturgeon caviar ($73), 1.5 lb Maine Lobster Risotto ($79), Little Gem Caesar ($23), Veal Parmigiana ($96), Black Truffle Casarecce ($47), Dry-Aged Prime Ribeye ($144) and Dover Sole ($110).
